references.text: Similar to the action in verse 20 where Martha meets Jesus while Mary remains seated in the house. In verses 28-29, Mary also meets Jesus after being called out of the house, creating a parallel in how the two sisters respond to Jesus' arrival.

Describes the situation where Mary sits in the house while others are outside, and then meets Jesus. This mirrors the contrast in verse 20 between Martha going out to meet Jesus and Mary sitting in the house.

Describes Jesus' reaction when he meets Mary who is weeping, after she has come out of the house. This is a direct consequence of the action in verse 20 where Mary sits in the house while Martha meets Jesus first.
